confirmed_product_defects.MECHANISM: obligation-content coverage gap: runtime coverage review treats a claim as covering a semantic obligation when the claim self-declares that obligation, so content-level gaps inside an obligation are invisible; the bounded revision only helps when the gap is detected, and in the detected case (g013) one revision still produced no claim for the missing obligation despite supporting evidence already cited
confirmed_product_defects.OWNING_LAYER: A1 (with runtime coverage-review granularity as an enabling factor)
confirmed_product_defects.GENERIC_REPAIR_HYPOTHESIS: make coverage review evaluate semantic support of each obligation's content across claims rather than accepting claim self-mapping, and give the bounded revision an explicit content-extraction directive per missing obligation; no Gold IDs, no case-specific phrases
confirmed_product_defects.RISK: medium: stricter coverage may raise revision/refusal rates; must be bounded and re-validated
confirmed_product_defects.MINIMUM_DEVELOPMENT_TEST: deterministic unit test that a claim self-declaring an obligation without obligation-content support does not satisfy coverage; and that revision with supporting evidence in the citation-eligible pool emits a claim for a missing obligation
